articles.title: Hegseth Visits Rocket Lab On 'Arsenal Of Freedom' Tour
articles.mainIdea: Hegseth Visits Rocket Lab On 'Arsenal Of Freedom' Tour
articles.summary: Benzinga: Hegseth Visits Rocket Lab On 'Arsenal Of Freedom' Tour. Last Friday, U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth visited Rocket Lab Corp. (NASDAQ:RKLB) headquarters as part of his “Arsenal of Freedom” tour, celebrating a major shift in how the Pentagon views the private space sector. During the visit, Hegseth — who dubs himself the “Secretary of War” — positioned Rocket Lab as a cornerstone of the nation's modern defense industrial base. In the Trump 2.0 era and his peace through strength mantra, it may be advantageous for contractors to be smaller and more focused, rather than seeking the scale benefits and diversification the industry has pursued in the past.
